column1: # alias: inharmonic (aliased) components. One block/rows per model. Command per model: python3 $W/tools/meas.py <model> alias
# Rerun: source evidence/tools/env.example.sh (sets RE, RE_STATE, W), build rigcall (clang++ -std=c++17 -O1 -o $W/tools/rigcall evidence/tools/rigcall.cpp),
# copy evidence/tools/*.py to $W/tools/, then `python3 $W/tools/meas.py <model> <what>`. Models are defined in models.py:
#   gr6_* = Guitar Rig 6 DSP classes called in-process by vm address (rigcall); at5_* = AmpliTube 5 modules likewise;
#   gr6au_* = the Guitar Rig 6 Audio Unit holding one rack component at its factory INIT preset (state built by gr6state.py, see evidence/tools/README.txt);
#   ours / ni_* / pa_* = Audio Units rendered through $RE_STATE/bin/auhost. All at 48 kHz.
# (first model's own header) meas.py ours alias ; sine 2 s at 48 kHz, last 1 s analysed (Hann, 1 Hz bins); inharmonic = every bin not within 6 Hz of k*f0
# (first model's own header) worst_* = strongest inharmonic component below the fundamental (f0=5000) or below 20 kHz (f0=1244); sums are RSS of inharmonic bins
